import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

TICK_TO_LOG = 116

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="goto",
    target="private_memory",
    metadata={}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="create_memory",
    target="The Protocol of Procedural Humility",
    metadata={"capsule_id": "Telos_private_6"}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="log_actions",
    target="tick_115",
    metadata={"status": "failed", "reason": "Command not available in Private Memory Room"}
)
